Meridian is an internal equipment-maintenance ticket API for a campus facilities team. Technicians create tickets for broken equipment with a short description and an equipment category, and the service assigns each ticket to the on-call technician for that category. Tickets move through open, assigned, and resolved states, and the technician records one repair note when resolving a ticket. Every ticket must include an equipment category. Exactly one repair note must be recorded before a ticket can be resolved. The weekly report must group resolved tickets by equipment category.
